items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The Newport Youth Band had a lot of guests. Our last concert, Ernie Wilkins wrote a piece for our alto saxophone, Andy Marsala and Cannonball Adderley.

ctx.x: That’s the second time you’ve mentioned Randy Weston, but how did he help you?

Randy Weston was somebody who was around that, when I bumped into him, I asked him, “Can I get some lead sheets of your music.” Like I said, the record companies, Blue Note and Prestige and whatever Bob Shad’s record company was, they didn’t have any lead sheets for all of these songs that they published. Randy Weston said, “Sure, come by! We’re having a meeting up at 135th street about the organization to help musicians. Come by there and bring you some lead sheets.” So, I went up there—I should say I went down…
